## 1.0.0 (2026-11-05)

### ✨ New Features

* add CinemaHQ patches for version 8.9 and APKM file type ([db00ab8](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/commit/db00ab8156834fffabd2191d71590dc263fb51f9))
* fix instruction removal logic in setBody for bytecode patches ([9568775](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/commit/9568775d9b6eccd7af74d7558b7adc5b28c55733))
* release version 1.2.0 with CinemaHQ patches ([00ca251](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/commit/00ca2514328dfc294043c60bc02b9b6f02afbcc2))
* support APKM, XAPK, APKS and APK file types for CinemaHQ 8.9 ([c6bea11](https://github.com/AbShaheen184/CinemaHQ-Morphe_Patches/commit/c6bea1175ffd5490e19c883302a0947a13866675))

patches.name: Disable background service relaunch receivers
patches.description: The app's BootReceiver, Appsalt's BootReceiver and Hopmn's NetworkStateReceiver no longer relaunch the background services on boot or on connectivity change.

patches.name: Neutralize Appsalt reward service
patches.description: Stops the Appsalt rewards/loyalty service from running. It stays declared, but it terminates itself on start and does no work.

patches.name: Neutralize Hopmn bandwidth sharing
patches.description: Stops the Hopmn SDK from selling your upload bandwidth. The service stays declared so the app does not crash, but it acquires no wake lock, registers nothing and stops itself immediately.
